function.name: hotel_search_find_hotels
function.description: Search for hotels based on location and amenities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but the current search tool only supports a limited set of amenities—Breakfast, Fitness Centre, Free Wi‑Fi, and Parking. It doesn’t include options for vegetarian meals or spa services, which are key to your yoga retreat request.

If you’d like, I can still search for hotels in New York that offer Breakfast and a Fitness Centre (or any combination of the supported amenities). Alternatively, you could let me know if you’d like to broaden the search to other nearby locations or different types of accommodations.
